title: Metric cut and form tap pre-drills and process policy

source.standard: ISO 2306:1972 (ISO metric, normal engagement; based on ISO 965-1 minor diameters)
source.note: M3–M6 rows visually checked in ISO 2306:1972 Table 1 (published preview, printed page 1), 2026-11-09. Drill diameters and the listed ISO minor diameter limits are not interchangeable; D − P is a check for these coarse sizes. Only these diameter/pitch pairs are eligible for cut tapping.

form.note: Tapmatic inch formula converted to mm. Shop assumption 65% formed thread, rounded to 0.01 mm; manufacturer confirmation remains necessary.

policy.note: step2cam judgement: prefer a matching tap for small metric threads in known nonferrous material; otherwise retain thread milling. This cutoff is not a standard.

diameter_tolerance_note: ±0.02 mm matching tolerance is step2cam judgement, not an ISO tolerance class.
